## Summary

Describe the problem and the change.

## Change Type

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Security
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Refactoring
- [ ] Tests

## Validation

List the commands you ran and their results.

- [ ] npm run lint
- [ ] npm test
- [ ] npm run build
- [ ] Added or updated tests where behavior changed

## Review Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and understandable.
- [ ] Documentation reflects the actual behavior.
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, or private user data are included.
- [ ] Authentication and authorization behavior was considered where relevant.
- [ ] AI-assisted implementation was reviewed and materially relevant assistance is disclosed.
